title: lipocarpha filiformis
intro: Lipocarpha filiformis, commonly known as needle sedge, is a species of plant in the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its leaves and stems providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Lipocarpha filiformis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
